about: The structure of conversations on the new core. Each subject is a record the speaker holds. The other person asks or tells; every choice answers that line (rule R3) with a different move. Every line is composed from the English engine's mined speech bank (data/english/parts/conversation.json, src/director/mined-words.ts); the lie line exists only for a question about the player's own record that the listener does not already know.
